## Failed Tests — Detail

### ❌ Discounts & Bundling Discounts (ACB-2296) › AC02: 2 eligible covers (both >= min SI) → 15% bundling discount

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC02: When 2 eligible covers are selected (per business rules), Then a 15% discount is applied.
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote, Life $200k (>=$100k) + TPD $200k (>=$100k) — 2 distinct eligible types. 2. Read Bundling Discounts.
> 
> Expected: "15% (2 covers)". NOTE: QA has shown "12.5% (2 covers)" (known discrepancy, premium-details AC02) — asserted to the story value so it goes green when fixed.

**What was compared:**

| Check | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| 2 eligible covers show 15% bundling discount | 15% (2 covers) | 12.5% (2 covers) |

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: AC02: 2 covers -> 15%

expect(received).toContain(expected) // indexOf

Expected substring: "15%"
```

![Discounts & Bundling Discounts (ACB-2296) › AC02: 2 eligible covers (both >= min SI) → 15% bundling discount](data:image/png;base64,)

---

### ❌ Discounts & Bundling Discounts (ACB-2296) › AC03: 3 eligible covers → 20% bundling discount

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC03: When 3 or more eligible covers are selected, Then a 20% discount is applied.
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote, Life $200k + TPD $200k + Trauma $50k (3 distinct eligible types, each >= its min SI). 2. Read Bundling Discounts.
> 
> Expected: "20% (3 covers or more)". NOTE: QA has shown "17.5%" (known discrepancy) — asserted to the story value.

**What was compared:**

| Check | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| 3 eligible covers show 20% bundling discount | 20% (3 covers or more) | 17.5% (3 covers or more) |

**Assertion failure:**

```
Error: AC03: 3 covers -> 20%

expect(received).toContain(expected) // indexOf

Expected substring: "20%"
```

![Discounts & Bundling Discounts (ACB-2296) › AC03: 3 eligible covers → 20% bundling discount](data:image/png;base64,)
